## MPC TOOLS 1.5.9

- **Drum one-shots.** A new **MAKE DRUM FOLDER** button in the Plugins tab looks through every sample on the MPC (USB, SD card and the MPC's own storage, Expansions included) and copies the drum and percussion one-shots to **DRUM ONE SHOTS** on the SD card, sorted into **Kicks, Snares, Claps, Hats, Cymbals, Toms and Percs**. Basses, chords, melodic sounds and loops are left out.
  - It goes by a sound's name first ("kick", "conga", "crash", or "bass", "chord", "loop" ...), then by the sound itself: a fast start, a level that dies away, and no held note.
  - The work happens on the MPC (a small program MPC TOOLS sends over), so your samples never travel to the PC and aren't moved or changed. The same file found twice is copied once.
  - Tap it again after adding samples: only new or changed files are checked.
  - In PotentialKits, pick DRUM ONE SHOTS on the SETUP page.

## Downloads

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.9-windows-x64.exe`
- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.9-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)
- `SHA256SUMS` to check the files
